description: Defines internal structures and functions for flat string representation in the Abseil Cord implementation, including size calculations, memory management, and class CordRepFlat.

classes.name: CordRepFlat
classes.description: Represents a flat string node in the internal Cord data structure, with methods for creation, deletion, and data access.

methods.name: NewImpl
methods.description: Creates a new CordRepFlat with specified maximum size and optional arguments.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new CordRepFlat with default maximum size.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a CordRepFlat instance, deallocating memory.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a CordRepFlat containing specified data with optional extra capacity.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data stored in the flat node.

methods.name: Capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum payload size of the flat node.

methods.name: AllocatedSize
methods.description: Returns the total allocated size (payload + overhead) of the flat node.
